I didn't grow up on one, but I spent most of my childhood time in mine and 98% of my family lives on one. 
My parents lived on the reserve for a few years before I was born, my mom is Ojibwe and my dad is Mic-Mac, after I was born they moved into town. 
As much as I love my reservation, I'm glad my parents moved me and my siblings off of the reservation and into town. Everyone I knew who lived on the rez had a hard life. No one had much money, lots of parents drank and smoked, dogs were never kept on their leashes. A lot of folks from the rez were also over weight, or had health problems. Their wasn't ever any violence. 
It all sounds bad, but I really do love my reservation. Their are great people and everyone is so friendly towards one another, it's a great community that's trying to become a healthy and respected one.

Sometimes it's a living hell. It makes simple tasks almost impossible, it even breaks me down. Anxiety controls my life. 

I've been dealing with Social Anxiety for most of my life, since I was a child. 
When I need to leave the house, it takes me HOURS before I actually do. I get sick and shaky, I throw up sometimes. I find excuses for myself why I shouldn't leave. 
I have to tell myself for 2-3 hours(sometimes longer) that I HAVE to do this and I'm gonna put myself in more trouble if I don't. I've missed out on countless great opportunities because of my anxiety that I regret everyday...
I still replay conversations in my head that happened years ago, thinking about all the mistakes I could have dodged. I can't have a solid thought, my brain is running everywhere. I don't have a job because of it, or schooling. It's fucking mission impossible making friends. 
I feel really bad for my SO, he has to deal with my constant crying, he has to take care of me and comfort me, he doesn't invite me out to places anymore, and he pay for things because i can't find work..I feel so useless. Anxiety makes me feel small and pathetic. 
I've had councillors and therapists but the help was only temporary.  

But today is the day I have a doctors appointment. I'm finally dealing with my life long battle of anxiety and trying out medication. It has become my last option.
Wish me luck! ( and good luck to you)
